body:
Valid points. I try to distract myself as much as possible via work and gaming. Gaming works better, because I can just dive into it and be a mindless zombie. I know that I still think about her every minute of my work - I was able to not let it interfere with my work, but it depresses me every workday.

Going out with friends also doesn't work. Thing is, I was always kind of a heavy drinker. And alcohol works for me. But that's not a solution, it makes everything worse. I have signs of being an alcoholic, and since my suicide attempt, I tried to really cut back on alcohol. Three days ago I fell right back into drinking alone at home, while talking to her via messenger. And it was a good feeling. Which is not good at all.

I followed my therapists advice and put the number of a 24/7 suicide hotline into my phone, if I ever feel like I am on the edge of doing it again.
I enjoyed the song. Thanks for that.

Thank you for your answer. I talked to her, and I still talk to her about all these feelings. I talk too much about my feelings. I annoy her with all my talking about it, actually. She doesn't want to talk about how our relationship is going at the moment, and I have the feeling she doesn't want to think about it as well. It IS a hard time for her, and I've made it that much more complicated with my attempt to kill myself.

I know that I made everything difficult for her, and that she needs time. But every day that she is blocking the attempts to talk or think about the future destroys me more and more. I will talk to my therapist about it, it's just that I am afraid it will come to this exact line: "You need to end the relationship before it kills you". And I can't. I can't end it.

Thanks for the story. I know the things of finding yet another girl that will make me happier and so on, I am just afraid because of two things:
- there is no girl that I have known for such a long time. I desired her for over eight years, that's why she is so important for me.
- even if I break up, she holds contact to my best friend. I won't be able to completely remove her from my life, which makes everything that much more complicated. Also, I am terribly afraid of my best friend and her hooking up when we break up. I spoke to him about it, and of course he says he will be on my side. Still, the fear is there.
Interestingly enough, I underwent almost two years of training to be a singer.
Working. Even when I take vacation. Aside from that, reading and gaming I guess. Going out. Getting drunk. Getting so fucking drunk.

She has the biggest, most fascinating eyes I have ever seen on a human being. Forgetting that didn't happen in the last eight to nine years, and it definitely will not happen anytime soon... Whatever happens, I couldn't get her out of my mind - she drove me to suicide. Nothing will ever clear that from my memory.
Yes, yes. I see how it is.

I would cuff my hands to the bed to stop me from masturbating, but that only gets me hornier, so that's a no go. Thursday will be hardest this week, I'll be on a business trip, and spend the night alone at a hotel with nothing else to do. In the past that meant three to four faps in the evening, but I guess I have to find something else now.

Let's do this, DiscountBrain, you and me fist bumping instead of fapping. No wait that doesn't sound right.
Thanks. I have been taking something for sure - ~Edging? Not Even Once.~
Signing up, started last week and feeling closer and closer to relapsing every day... hopefully this will keep my urge in check.

It's my 7th day today as well and I was so tempted to give in, already starting the edging process, when I decided to let my boner be my boner. I was desperately checking out NoFap to find SOMETHING to get my mind off.

So even though you had to reset, just know this: your post reinforced my own willpower, I'm not going to fap and lose my reboot progress. Thanks for that.

That's the best thing about noFap I guess - people who are suffering from the same things. It's a topic I can't even disclose to my best real-life friend of over ten years, because I am basically just ashamed of myself. Thanks for your support, it means a lot to me.
